title: cyanea lobata subsp. baldwinii
intro: Cyanea lobata subsp. baldwinii, commonly known as the Kamehameha's spear or Hawaiian lobelia, is a flowering plant native to the islands of Hawaii. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional Hawaiian medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cyanea lobata subsp. baldwinii include its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which can help to soothe wounds and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
